LanguageData.LP_Class_Gunslinger.label: gunslinger
LanguageData.LP_Class_Gunslinger.description: The D&D gunslinger lives on grit and a good gun: bonded gun, gunslinger's dodge, violent shot (may jam), targeting, dead shot, menacing shot; capstone death's shot. Firearms only (industrial ranged weapons plus this mod's magic guns and dwarven firearms; no bows, crossbows, staves or grenades). Way at level 3: drifter (short gun + blade), pistolero (short guns), sniper (long guns) or vanguard (heavy weapons). Also a gunsmith: crafts faster with a chance of +1 quality on firearms. Scales with gunslinging power (Shooting, Dexterity). Resource: grit (gained by killing or downing enemies with firearms, and while sleeping). Martial class: extra attack, fighting style.
